description: baseline Unet-resnet34 512 BCE+Dice topk pooling; unstable - collapses to empty mask after ep9
dice on positive films only + cosine LR; fixes empty-mask collapse (30min budget)
same recipe at 40min budget - reference for the 40min family
2-GPU DDP ~100 epochs; no gain over run3 - now overfitting not compute limited
per-side apical crop 2x magnification + mirrored left apex - large gain
aborted early - 2 GPUs gave no speedup on the crop pipeline (dataloader bound)
same recipe on pre-cut crops - repeat of run5 within noise (run-to-run spread ~0.01)
1:1 ChestX-ray14 negatives - cleaner alerts (ppv .55 vs .50) but far fewer SIIM passes; net worse
GPU augmentation + 2 GPUs (~64 passes vs 35): no gain - saturated on compute not data
ChestX-ray14 negatives at matched SIIM exposure - still worse; quieter (ppv .53) but less discriminative
auxiliary per-apex classification head blended with pooled map - best so far; recall .766->.825
ConvNeXt-tiny encoder - no gain over resnet34; capacity is not the limit
3x device-bearing normal apices - same AP as run11 but cleaner alerts (ppv .556 fp 6.0 vs .509 7.7)
exponential moving average of weights - best so far; recall_at_ppv70 .714
contralateral apex as 2nd channel - clearly worse; the two sides are not registered
test-time averaging over 5 views - best so far; higher at every checkpoint than run14
per-apex head weight 1.0 used directly as the alert score - best so far
stronger augmentation + block dropout - best AUC and r@ppv70 but primary metric slightly lower
3x positive apices - peaks early (ep13) then overfits; ties run17 on the primary metric
heavier weight decay + head dropout - no gain over run17
seed repeat of run17 - 0.727 vs 0.747; run-to-run spread on validation is about 0.02
classifier only - overfits badly; the pixel-level branch is a useful auxiliary signal
wider apical crop (margin .55) - within seed noise of run17, best film recall .870 though
encoder pre-trained on ChestX-ray14 apical crops - worse than ImageNet init (noisy film-level pretext)
batch 32 with matched LR - within seed noise of run17
focal loss on the per-apex head - within seed noise, no gain
mixup between apex crops - best AUC .9665 but primary metric within noise of run17
auxiliary lung-field outlining - within seed noise, no gain
slower weight averaging (0.9995) - best overall; recall_at_ppv70 .743 film_recall .851
third seed of the final configuration - 0.743 vs 0.750; configuration confirmed
